plugins.name: user-hud
plugins.description: A control panel above the Claude Code prompt, laid out as cards in one to three columns by width, in seven modules you turn on or off: your other sessions (needs you, working, done), the context as a ten-cell battery and where your tokens go, model and effort pickers in three styles, prompt-cache countdown with a 2-minute keep-warm alert, guesses Claude made for you to mark right or wrong, handoff buttons, and next steps.

plugins.name: code-reference
plugins.description: Replies that point at code: ask with /code-reference (or review a PR) and each place the reply names opens in a code pane beside it, the prose linked to it and boxed under each section. Drawn the same in the terminal and the desktop app. Was pr-review-ui.

plugins.name: ask
plugins.description: A side chat in a pane that reads the main chat, scrolls and draws: /ask a question, /draw a diagram. Nothing goes back to the main chat unless you send it. Answers are Mermaid drawn as box art in the terminal and as SVG in the desktop app.

plugins.name: delegator
plugins.description: Every subagent Claude starts waits for your approval: approve, refuse, approve all for the turn, change its model (suggested by the task's complexity) or add a note to its task. The pane then follows each agent as it runs, a pixel character for its role beside its context battery, tokens, estimated cost, time and reported steps, the same in the terminal and the desktop app.
